history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, tousled hair stands in an outdoor setting, likely a temple or traditional garden. He is wearing a loose-fitting, white, long-sleeved shirt with a band collar and a single chest pocket. Around his waist, he wears a traditional sarong or sash in a vibrant golden yellow with intricate white and gold patterns, layered over white trousers or a lower garment. He is also wearing dark sandals.

The background is lush and green, with abundant foliage, including trees with visible branches and leaves, and various smaller plants and bushes with green and red leaves. To the left of the man, there is a stone lantern with intricate carvings, typical of East Asian or Southeast Asian architecture. Behind him, a traditional wooden building with ornate carvings and a wooden door is visible, suggesting a Balinese or similar cultural setting. Steps lead up to the building, and more greenery flanks the entrance.

The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting it's daytime with the sun casting dappled shadows on the stone-tiled ground in front of the man. The overall color palette is dominated by the greens of the foliage, the white of the man's shirt, the golden yellow of his sarong, and the warm brown tones of the wooden architecture. The mood is serene and perhaps contemplative, with the man looking off to the right of the frame. The style is realistic with a focus on cultural attire and a natural, tropical environment.
